summary: The figure shows trends in tuberculosis (TB) incidence rates and new and relapse case notifications from 2000 to 2021 across six WHO regions. Incidence rates generally declined over time in all regions, with the African and South-East Asia regions having the highest incidence rates throughout the period. New and relapse case notifications show varied trends, with some regions like South-East Asia and Eastern Mediterranean showing increases, while others like the European and Americas regions show declines. The 2020 milestone incidence rate is marked by a red dashed line in each region, indicating target levels for TB incidence.
